info.title: Advisory Platform API
info.description:
Generated from lib/api/contract.ts — do not edit by hand.

Served by one Cloudflare Worker alongside the static site: page requests are answered from the assets store and never invoke the Worker, only `/api/*` does. Auth lives at `/api/auth/*` and is handled by better-auth, so it is not described here.

Money is always minor units (satang) as an integer; dates are always ISO 8601 UTC.
